title: Gifts for men who have everything UK: 11 ideas he won't own yet
seoTitle: Gifts for Men Who Have Everything UK: 11 Fresh Ideas
description: Gifts for men who have everything, at Black Friday prices: a smart telescope, an Oura Ring, AI glasses and a 4K Matrix box set from £39.99.
intro:
**Our best overall gift for a man who has everything is the Seestar S30 Plus smart telescope at £426 on Amazon: almost nobody owns one, and it photographs galaxies from the back garden. Best cheap gift: the Philips OneBlade 360 at £39.99. Best splurge: the Garmin fēnix 8 at a record-low £484.99.**

Every price below was published on 19 or 20 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (19–30 November). Some Amazon prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

deals.name: Seestar S30 Plus smart telescope
deals.note: An all-in-one telescope and camera he controls from a phone app. It finds objects by itself and builds up photos of nebulae and galaxies, even from a light-polluted garden. The saving is small, but it's a gift he almost certainly doesn't have.

deals.name: Oura Ring 5 (black or silver)
deals.note: A sleep and recovery tracker for the man who won't wear a smartwatch to bed. £100 off in the standard finishes. You need his ring size, and the app needs a monthly membership after the trial.

deals.name: Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm, black)
deals.note: Garmin's flagship outdoor watch with maps, multi-week battery and every sport going. Reviewers called £484.99 its lowest price yet.

deals.name: HTC Vive Eagle AI glasses
deals.note: Sunglasses with a camera, open-ear speakers and a voice assistant built in. A genuine novelty for the early adopter, now about £80 off (from £349).

deals.name: Lego Icons Star Trek: U.S.S. Enterprise
deals.note: A big display build for a sci-fi fan, 15% off. Lego for adults is one of the safest bets for a man who buys himself everything else, because sets retire and can't be bought later.

deals.name: Aurzen Zip Tri-Fold portable projector
deals.note: A pocket-sized projector that folds flat, for films on a bedroom ceiling, a tent wall or a hotel room. £115 off.

deals.name: Philips Hue Play HDMI Sync Box 8K
deals.note: Makes Hue lights behind and around the TV react to whatever's on screen, from films to games. Only worth it if he already has Hue lights; a third off.

deals.name: Philips Hue Essential starter kit
deals.note: The cheaper way into Hue smart lighting, 41% off. Pair it with the Sync Box above if he has neither.

deals.name: Nothing Ear (3a) wireless earbuds
deals.note: Noise-cancelling earbuds with Nothing's see-through design, £40 off. A good spare pair for the gym or the car even if he already owns AirPods.

deals.name: The Ultimate Matrix Collection (4K Ultra HD Blu-ray)
deals.note: All four films in 4K, about a fifth off. Physical 4K discs look and sound better than streaming, which film fans with a big TV appreciate.

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one blade. Even men with a drawer full of grooming kit tend to use this every week. It dipped slightly lower on Prime Day, so this is good rather than a record.

body:
## How to buy for a man who has everything

A man who "has everything" usually means one of two things: he buys what he wants as soon as he wants it, or he says he doesn't need anything. Either way, a better version of something he already owns rarely lands. What works is a gift in a category he hasn't got round to yet: a new hobby, an experience at home, or a clever gadget he'd never justify buying himself.

Three questions narrow it down fast:

- **What does he do at weekends?** Outdoors types get far more from a Garmin or a telescope than from another gadget for the living room.
- **Does he already have the system?** Hue accessories, like the Sync Box, only make sense if he has Hue lights. If he doesn't, the starter kit is the safer gift.
- **Will it need a subscription?** The Oura Ring needs a monthly membership after the trial. That's fine if he's keen on sleep data, less so if it's a surprise.

## Best overall, best cheap, best splurge

- **Best overall: Seestar S30 Plus, £426.** It turns stargazing into a phone-app hobby with no setup skills needed, and it's the gift on this list he's least likely to own.
- **Best cheap: Philips OneBlade 360, £39.99.** Useful, well reviewed, and £20 off.
- **Best splurge: Garmin fēnix 8, £484.99.** At £215 off, it's the lowest price we've seen on Garmin's top outdoor watch.

If he's a reader or a commuter, an audiobook gift is an easy add-on. An [Audible free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/audible/mlp) gives him a free audiobook to keep, and it's free to cancel. See our [Audible free trial guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) for how it works.

## Good prices to look for

- **Oura Ring 5:** £299 is £100 off and the price to beat in the standard finishes. Gold and other premium finishes are £399.
- **Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm):** under £500 is excellent; it was £699.99 for most of the year.
- **Nothing Ear (3a):** £59 is the price to wait for; anything near £99 is full price.
- **Philips OneBlade 360:** around £40 is a fair gift price.
- **Lego Icons sets:** 10–20% off is normal for big adult sets; deeper cuts are rare.

## Do you need Prime for these prices?

Some of Amazon's Black Friday prices are for Prime members only, and Prime also gets you faster delivery on gifts. If you don't have it, the [Prime 30-day free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale and is free to cancel. Our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time it.

Shopping for your dad rather than a partner or friend? Our [Christmas gifts for Dad](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-dad-2026/) guide has more everyday ideas, and our [gifts for him under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-him-under-50/) covers tighter budgets.

## Buy now or wait?

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November. Prices on watches, earbuds and smart home kit usually go back up in December, and the Boxing Day sales are too late for Christmas. If one of these is the right gift, buying this week is the safe move. Amazon's extended returns usually cover Christmas gifts bought from November, but check the returns date on your order.

## FAQs

### What do you buy a man who says he wants nothing?

Something that starts a new hobby or makes time at home more fun: a smart telescope, a big Lego build, a portable projector or a 4K film collection. Avoid upgrades to things he's already chosen himself, like his phone or headphones.

### Is the Seestar telescope easy to use?

Yes. It's designed for beginners. You set it on its tripod, open the app, pick an object and it finds and photographs it automatically. Clear skies are the only real requirement.

### Is the Oura Ring worth it as a gift?

Only if you know his ring size and he's interested in sleep and recovery data. The ring needs an Oura membership after the free trial, so it carries an ongoing cost.

### What's a good gift for a man who has everything under £50?

The Philips OneBlade 360 (£39.99), the 4K Matrix collection (£48) or a Philips Hue starter kit (£64.99, just over). An Audible trial with a book picked for him is a thoughtful free extra.

### Will these prices drop further before Christmas?

Unlikely. Black Friday Week prices are usually the lowest before Christmas, and most return to normal in early December.
